description: Flat, record-level metadata schema for virus-host protein interaction observations derived from affinity purification followed by mass spectrometry during viral infection studies.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record representing one observed virus-host protein interaction event or evidence row. Example: 'VHI_000001'.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the originating study or project. Example: 'PRJNA123456'.

virus_name.descr: Common name of the virus used in the infection or expression system. Example: 'SARS-CoV-2'.

virus_taxon_id.descr: NCBI Taxonomy identifier for the virus. Example: 2697049.

virus_strain.descr: Viral strain, isolate, lineage, or variant designation. Example: 'Delta', 'USA-WA1/2020'.

virus_genome_type.descr: Virus genome type or replication class. Acceptable values may include 'ssRNA+', 'ssRNA-', 'dsDNA', 'ssDNA', 'dsRNA', 'retrovirus', or similar controlled terms.

viral_protein_name.descr: Name of the viral protein serving as bait or detected interaction partner. Example: 'Nsp5', 'Spike'.

viral_protein_accession.descr: Database accession or standardized identifier for the viral protein. Example: UniProt accession.

viral_protein_tag.descr: Epitope tag or affinity tag fused to the viral protein, if applicable. Example: 'FLAG', 'HA', 'GFP'.

host_species.descr: Host organism species name. Example: 'Homo sapiens'.

host_taxon_id.descr: NCBI Taxonomy identifier for the host species. Example: 9606.

host_cell_line.descr: Host cell line used in the experiment. Example: 'HEK293T', 'Vero E6', 'A549'.

host_tissue.descr: Host tissue of origin, if applicable. Example: 'lung', 'kidney'.

host_cell_type.descr: Cell type or primary cell designation when relevant. Example: 'epithelial cell', 'primary macrophage'.

infection_status.descr: Infection condition of the host sample. Example values: 'infected', 'mock', 'transfected', 'co-expressed'.

multiplicity_of_infection.descr: MOI used for infection, if applicable. Report as number of infectious particles per cell.

time_post_infection_hours.descr: Time elapsed after infection or transfection at sample collection, in hours.

treatment_name.descr: Additional treatment applied to the host cells or infection system. Example: 'interferon-beta', 'proteasome inhibitor', 'none'.

treatment_concentration.descr: Treatment concentration at the time of exposure, with units implied by the corresponding protocol. Example: 10.0.

treatment_unit.descr: Unit for treatment concentration. Example values: 'nM', 'uM', 'ng/mL'.

biological_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for the biological replicate. Example: 'rep1', 'B2'.

technical_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for the technical replicate, if used. Example: 'tech1'.

bait_type.descr: Type of bait used in affinity purification. Example values: 'viral protein', 'host protein', 'antibody', 'tag'.

bait_host_protein_name.descr: Host protein bait name if the bait is a host protein rather than a viral protein. Example: 'ACE2'.

bait_accession.descr: Standard database accession for the bait protein. Example: UniProt accession or RefSeq identifier.

affinity_purification_method.descr: Affinity purification approach used to isolate complexes. Example: 'AP-MS', 'co-IP', 'TAP-MS'.

capture_reagent.descr: Capture reagent used for enrichment. Example: antibody name, bead type, or tag-binding resin.

lysis_buffer.descr: Brief description or identifier of the lysis buffer/composition used for extraction.

crosslinking_used.descr: Indicates whether chemical crosslinking was applied before purification or MS analysis.

crosslinker_name.descr: Name of crosslinker used, if applicable. Example: 'DSP', 'formaledehyde', 'DSS'.

mass_spectrometry_instrument.descr: Mass spectrometer model used for acquisition. Example: 'Orbitrap Fusion Lumos'.

ms_acquisition_mode.descr: Acquisition mode used in MS. Example values: 'DDA', 'DIA', 'targeted'.

protein_search_software.descr: Software used to identify peptides/proteins from MS data. Example: 'MaxQuant', 'Proteome Discoverer', 'Mascot'.

search_database_version.descr: Version or release date of the protein sequence database used for searching. Example: 'UniProt human 2024_01'.

interaction_partner_name.descr: Name of the host or viral protein identified as interacting with the bait in this record. Example: 'HSP90AA1'.

interaction_partner_accession.descr: Standard accession for the interaction partner protein. Example: UniProt accession.

interaction_partner_organism.descr: Organism of the interaction partner protein, typically host or virus. Example: 'Homo sapiens'.

interaction_evidence_type.descr: Evidence supporting the interaction. Example values: 'MS identification', 'reciprocal IP', 'validated by co-IP', 'proximity labeling'.

interaction_detection_method.descr: Specific method used to detect the interaction. Example: 'AP-MS', 'co-IP MS', 'BioID', 'TurboID'.

interaction_direction.descr: Directionality of the interaction record relative to the bait. Example values: 'bait-prey', 'host-viral', 'viral-host'.

interaction_classification.descr: Whether the interaction is physical, putative, or indirect based on analysis and validation. Example values: 'physical', 'putative', 'indirect'.

spectral_count.descr: Number of spectra assigned to the interaction partner in this record, if applicable.

peptide_count.descr: Number of unique peptides supporting identification of the interaction partner.

sequence_coverage_percent.descr: Percent sequence coverage for the identified protein, if reported.

enrichment_fold_change.descr: Fold enrichment of the partner in bait vs control samples. Example: 3.5.

log2_enrichment.descr: Log2-transformed enrichment value for the interaction partner. Example: 1.81.

p_value.descr: Statistical significance of the enrichment or interaction score.

adjusted_p_value.descr: Multiple-testing corrected p-value or FDR-adjusted value.

interaction_score.descr: Composite interaction confidence score reported by the analysis pipeline or study.

confidence_level.descr: Curation or computational confidence category. Example values: 'high', 'medium', 'low'.

validated_experimentally.descr: Indicates whether the interaction was independently validated by an orthogonal assay.

validation_method.descr: Orthogonal validation method used, if validated. Example: 'reciprocal co-IP', 'pull-down', 'yeast two-hybrid'.

subcellular_location_bait.descr: Observed subcellular location of the bait protein, if reported. Example: 'cytoplasm', 'nucleus', 'ER'.

subcellular_location_partner.descr: Observed subcellular location of the interaction partner, if reported. Example: 'Golgi apparatus'.

functional_annotation.descr: Short functional description of the interaction context, such as immune evasion, replication, assembly, trafficking, or signaling. Example: 'innate immune suppression'.

drug_target_relevance.descr: Indicates whether the interaction suggests a potential antiviral drug target or host dependency factor.

druggability_annotation.descr: Free-text or controlled label describing druggability status of the host protein. Example: 'kinase', 'enzyme', 'undruggable', 'known target'.

notes.descr: Additional comments or caveats relevant to this specific record, such as contamination warnings or unusually low abundance.
